framing.placement_vs_timing: Test year: no dynamic carbon search (K, W, L) improves on the static clean-region ranking S (H3 not supported); K emits more than S (10.0 t more; K − S = +10.0 t, b = 4 95% interval [+1.5 t, +19.3 t]; the interval excludes zero); W and L are not distinguishable from S (W − S = +4.9 t [-3.6 t, +14.8 t]; L − S = +5.1 t [-4.2 t, +15.3 t]). Waiting in Utah alone saves about 0.7% (W_time 0.72%, L_time 0.75% vs U); the saving comes from moving work (L 22.51% vs U), mostly to BPAT (66% of L's remote execution energy).
framing.greedy_search: Per-job greedy search, including hindsight H, is not a cohort optimum; holding scarce BPAT slots for cleaner hours pushes later jobs to dirtier sites.
framing.h_is_diagnostic: H uses realized (filled) truth; it is never a contender
